items.title: Chevening Scholarship 2027/28
items.summary: One-year fully funded master's at any UK university, in any subject (public health, health policy, global health and similar fit well). Needs two years of work experience and a return to Nigeria for two years after.

items.title: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
items.window: Annual call, usually opens in autumn. Check the CSC page for the current deadline.
items.summary: Full-time taught master's in the UK for candidates from eligible Commonwealth countries. Covers tuition, living allowance and airfare. Public health and global health courses are common choices.

items.title: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
items.window: Annual call. Check the CSC page for eligibility by country and the current deadline.
items.summary: Fully funded PhD study in the UK for candidates from eligible Commonwealth countries, including development-focused health research.

items.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program (graduate)
items.destination: Canada, Africa and other partner countries
items.window: Each partner university runs its own cycle. New calls are picked up automatically from the feeds below.
items.summary: Full funding for African graduates at partner universities such as Toronto, McGill, Cape Town, Makerere and Ashesi. Health programmes include MPH, health informatics and health administration.

items.title: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
items.window: Deadlines vary by course, mostly between August and October for the following year.
items.summary: Monthly stipend, tuition, health insurance and travel for master's courses relevant to development, including international health and public health programmes.

items.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
items.window: Nigeria applications are usually handled through the US Embassy Abuja. Check the Fulbright page for this year's dates.
items.summary: Graduate study in the US including master's and doctoral work in public health and related fields.

items.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
items.window: International students apply in two rounds, usually October and early December.
items.summary: Full-cost scholarships at the University of Cambridge for PhD and selected master's programmes, with a leadership and social-impact focus.

items.title: Clarendon Scholarships
items.window: Decided automatically from your graduate application, so apply by the January course deadline.
items.summary: Fully funded graduate scholarships at Oxford, awarded across all subjects including population health and medical sciences.

items.title: Rotary Peace Fellowships
items.window: Applications usually close in mid-May each year.
items.summary: Fully funded master's degree or professional certificate in peace and conflict studies. Suits doctors working in humanitarian and community health.

items.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
items.window: Application window changes yearly. Check the World Bank scholarships page.
items.summary: Master's study in development-related fields at approved universities, including public health, for professionals from developing countries.

items.title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
items.window: Usually opens around October and closes in the following months.
items.summary: Full master's funding in Sweden for professionals with leadership potential. Open to Nigerian citizens.

items.title: Australia Awards Africa
items.window: Usually opens in the first half of the year. Check the official page.
items.summary: Fully funded master's study in Australia for African professionals, with priority sectors that often include health.

items.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's (EMJM)
items.window: Each consortium sets its own deadline, mostly December to February.
items.summary: Joint master's programmes taught in two or more European countries, with scholarships covering tuition, travel and living costs. Several programmes are in public health, infectious disease and biomedicine.

items.title: Turkiye Burslari Scholarships
items.window: Applications normally run from January to late February.
items.summary: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend, health insurance and flights for master's and doctoral study.

items.title: Chinese Government Scholarship
items.window: Windows differ by route (bilateral or university track). Usually between January and April.
items.summary: Full scholarships for graduate study at Chinese universities, including clinical medicine and public health.

items.title: Mandela Rhodes Scholarship
items.window: Annual call, typically mid-year. Check the foundation page.
items.summary: Postgraduate funding for young Africans at South African universities, with a leadership development programme.

items.title: Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine scholarships for Nigerians
items.window: The most recent round closed on 15 April 2026. Check the page for the next intake.
items.summary: Funding for Nigerian applicants to master's courses in tropical medicine, public health and global health at LSTM.

items.title: EDCTP Global Health Fellowships
items.window: Calls are announced on the EDCTP website. Check for the current call.
items.summary: Career development fellowships for clinical researchers working on poverty-related infectious diseases in sub-Saharan Africa.

items.title: Fleming Fund Fellowship Scheme
items.window: Cohort calls are announced on the Fleming Fund site. Check for open rounds.
items.summary: Fellowships on antimicrobial resistance for health and laboratory professionals in low- and middle-income countries.

items.title: TDR Postgraduate Training Scheme
items.window: Calls are posted on the TDR site. Check for open rounds.
items.summary: Postgraduate training in implementation research for health professionals from low- and middle-income countries.

items.title: NLNG Postgraduate Scholarship
items.window: Announced once a year. Watch the NLNG site and national newspapers.
items.summary: Fully funded UK master's for Nigerian graduates, covering tuition, accommodation, living costs, flights and insurance.

items.title: TETFund postgraduate scholarships
items.window: Awarded through beneficiary institutions. Relevant if you join a Nigerian university as academic staff.
items.summary: Staff development awards for lecturers in public tertiary institutions, including medical specialisation in Nigerian universities.
